# Made-up exam for the tests (not the real golden set). Format: number | half | question
01 | dev | How tall is the blue lighthouse?
02 | held-out | What colour is the harbour ferry?
03 | dev | Who paints the fishing boats?
04 | held-out | When does the night market open?
05 | dev | How many steps lead to the chapel?
06 | held-out | What fruit grows on the north hill?
07 | held-out | Which bird nests on the pier?
08 | dev | Where is the old bakery?
09 | dev | How long is the coastal trail?
10 | held-out | Who keeps the village clock?
11 | dev | What is the harbour fee for kayaks?
12 | held-out | When was the stone bridge built?
13 | dev | What is the name of the island cat?
14 | held-out | How deep is the lagoon?
15 | dev | What do the bells play at noon?
16 | held-out | Who won the regatta in 1990?
17 | dev | What is the price of a moon ticket?
18 | held-out | How many dragons live in the cave?
19 | dev | What is the wifi password of the mayor?
20 | held-out | Which planet does the ferry visit?
